scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fytts/contracts && npm run build -w @fytts/api && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @fytts/api" "npm run dev -w @fytts/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fytts/contracts && npm run generate -w @fytts/api && npm run build -w @fytts/api && npm run build -w @fytts/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fytts/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @fytts/contracts && npm run test -w @fytts/api
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w @fytts/api" "npm run start -w @fytts/web"
